notes.title: Update #5 (v1.0.5)

- Switched resolution to 1920x1080 (Fullscreen).
- Added a new level "Potion of Greater Speed". 
- Adjusted the timer so that you always start a level with 30 seconds. 
- Fixed the timer not adding minutes after clicking an ingredient. 
- Made a few minor unnoticeable changes.
